title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：navy　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 navy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the clerk ① joined the navy that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the joining was the whole of the month. The ② navy, meaning the fleet itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; a navy, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ navy in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ navy at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A navy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the navy was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the fleet. The ⑥ navy, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; navy, he said, is either something you join or the only word that means both a fleet and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ navy had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ navy of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; navy, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ navy I remember is the fleet described in the file, which closed in 2001 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ navy, my mother said in 2003, is the only fleet that improves by being described; every navy, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like a fleet. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 海军（指办事处里每一支旁边的那一支）
B. n. 海军（指那支海军本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：join the navy 加入这一支海军
D. n. 海军（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 海军之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的海军之事）
F. n. 海军（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一支）
G. n. 海军、武备（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 武备（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: joined the navy that no applicant in the office would have described
The navy, meaning the fleet itself and not the stamp
the navy at the far counter
the navy was the whole of the matter
the navy had become a line in a file
The navy of the whole thing
A navy, my mother said in 2003

answers.why: join the navy 意为“加入这一支海军”，1994 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一支海军做了一遍。
navy 意为“海军”，指那支海军本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
navy 意为“海军”，指办事处里每一支旁边的那一支，每一支旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
navy 意为“海军”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
navy 意为“海军、武备”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这支武备就是那件事的全部。
navy 意为“武备”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那支海军，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
navy 意为“海军”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一支，到 1999 年这一支成了卷宗里的一行。
navy 意为“海军之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的海军之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
navy 意为“海军”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一支，2001 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一支。
navy 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，海军是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的海军。
